summary: Iteration 14 (core workflow + clutter removal + email invite). Backend: new test_iter14_core.py 6/6 pass (brief -> named sites NORTH-STORE/SOUTH-STORE with week 1/2 deadlines, apply creates 2 named sites, gap shows 1 short/2 short, re-read+apply does not duplicate; email-preview returns to/subject/text/sendable=false for .test, email-send 400 for .test, 404 for bad token; review shared_conditions; amendment diff reasons). Regression test_assemble_flow/iter6_guards/handoff_rules 24/24 pass. Frontend (Playwright, desktop+390px): demo organizer -> 3 projects; no project bar/back arrow/switcher; Guided tour + Reset on title row for canonical, hidden in real project; no 'Task X of 4', no 'Go to ...' buttons, no 'Next' eyebrow; plan-strip labels 'Make a checked draft' / 'Request review' / 'Fill in details' / none while waiting on partners; 'Check draft'; step persists in sessionStorage across reload; schedule grid shows site names + id + 'due week of'; invite rows full-width w/ week-of dates, advance/balance, full recipient email, no raw URL input; Request review / Email invitation / Copy link / I've shared it myself / Review as this partner (demo) all work; email dialog To/Subject/body, Send disabled + synthetic explanation; partner review labels + 'Send confirmation/Send change request/Send decline', confirm text mentions job-wide conditions + advance, confirm persists on reload; diff 'Why:' reasons + site names + week of/due dates; Summary shows week-of + 'Print / save PDF'; /projects/prj_bad shows Back to projects + Retry; new real project brief flow in UI works (no 'No site id', gap no-sites note before, shortages after). No horizontal overflow at 390px on Projects/Draft/Invite/Review. Two issues found (below).

minor.issue: On a fresh canonical demo shared_conditions is [] so the 'Job-wide conditions' row never shows. intake.job_conditions is empty at seed; the after-hours text is Alder's PARTNER condition. The job-wide row appears only after the organizer reads the customer brief and applies its job-condition reading (verified: then returns 'After-hours access has not been confirmed for every branch', source 'Customer brief (Synthetic), line 7', resolved false). Review request claimed canonical has one out of the box.

Applying only a job-condition reading on a project with links still regenerates the candidate as an amendment preview (recalc 'Candidate v2 recalculated as an amendment preview'), although conditions do not change any partner terms. Creates an unnecessary open preview that blocks other preview actions (409 'Finish or discard the open amendment preview first').
Partner diff Side text uses raw ISO dates ('Sunset Park branch (week 3, from 2026-11-09)') while everything else uses 'week of Nov 9, 2026'. Inconsistent formatting in amendment diff partner cards.
Site unknowns use internal ids ('NORTH-STORE deadline: unknown') rather than site names.

ui_bugs.issue: Before a link exists the card reads 'to no email yet' even when the partner has an email (alder@demo.assemble.test). Code uses p.link?.invite_email || p.terms.email, but partner_terms() has no email field, so the fallback is always empty. Misleading: the organizer thinks an email is missing.

design_issues.screen: Check > Paste a brief / Enter details manually
issues: Document date and Start date use the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy), and Kind uses a native <select>, not shadcn Calendar/Select. This doesn't match the rest of the UI.

Primary button reads 'Send email' (fine). For synthetic recipients the explanation is shown, but the disabled grey Send button is still the most prominent control. Consider hiding it or making 'Copy link' the primary action in the dialog.

action_items: PartnerCard recipient: add the partner email to the card data (e.g., from intake partners or add 'email' to partner_statuses payload) so it doesn't show 'no email yet' before Request review

Decide whether canonical fixture should seed the after-hours job condition into intake.job_conditions (so the Review 'Job-wide conditions' row shows by default), or update docs/tour to say it appears after reading the brief
Skip candidate recalculation in readings/apply when only job_condition readings are applied
Format _terms_summary dates as 'week of <Mon D, YYYY>' (or format on frontend) for diff partner cards
Optional: use site names in gap unknowns; replace native date/select inputs with shadcn components
critical_code_review_comments: project_routes._invite builds the review URL from the request Origin header; email-preview without an Origin yields a relative '/review/<token>' link (send is guarded, preview isn't). Consider a configured public base URL env var.
email-send has no resend throttle: the organizer can send repeatedly ('Email again'). Consider a cooldown per link.

extract_routes.week_of only works when start_date is already in intake. In the brief test the LLM converted the dates itself (SYSTEM rule), so this works, but a brief whose start date is applied in the same batch can still leave a date-text deadline invalid if the LLM returns the raw date.
Applying a job-condition reading triggers generate_candidate (see backend minor issue).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 medium UI bug: recipient 'no email yet')

test_credentials: Demo organizer via Login 'Organizer' button (synthetic-demo). Real organizer registered via API test_ui_*@example.com / password123 with firms.pilot_active=true.
seed_data_creation: Registered TEST organizers (test_*@example.com, test_ui_*@example.com) with TEST Audit Retail projects; demo sandboxes per Playwright run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Draft step has no crews preselected; click draft-include-alder/birch/cedar before draft-generate-button. Readings default to 0 selected; click readings-select-all then readings-apply-button. LLM brief extraction took ~15-20s. Job-wide conditions on review only appear after the brief's job-condition reading is applied. pytest.ini uses xdist; use -n 0 for ordered single-class runs.
rca of the issue: Recipient bug: PartnersTask.jsx line 39 falls back to p.terms.email, but logic.partner_terms() doesn't return email, so before a link exists the card always shows 'no email yet'.
